# `vfx-cue-sheet` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "vfx-cue-sheet" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/vfx-cue-sheet/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Sheet id, e.g. "combat". |
| `notes` | string | required | What the sheet covers and why, for owner review. |
| `rules` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The rules, most specific wins per event and layer. |
| `rules[].event` | `"DamageApplied"` \| `"PoiseBroken"` \| `"Died"` \| `"HitParried"` \| `"GuardBroken"` \| `"DodgedHit"` \| `"ActionPhaseChanged"` \| `"LocomotionEvents"` \| `"TelegraphStarted"` \| `"AttackHit"` \| `"AttackProjectileLaunched"` \| `"AttackEnded"` \| `"ActionRejected"` \| `"StaminaExhausted"` \| `"StaminaRecovered"` \| `"fireIgnited"` \| `"fireExtinguished"` \| `"fireBurntOut"` \| `"stimulusResolved"` \| `"propertyChanged"` \| `"factChanged"` \| `"signalReceived"` \| `"volumeEntered"` \| `"volumeExited"` \| `"physicsImpact"` \| `"ArrowFired"` \| `"arrowImpact"` \| `"breakableBroken"` \| `"doorStateChanged"` \| `"doorBlocked"` \| `"lockUnlocked"` \| `"lockRefused"` \| `"switchUsed"` \| `"mechanismJammed"` | required | The sim event that triggers the rule (see src/content/cue-events.ts for its facts). |
| `rules[].match` | map of string → string or boolean | `{}` | Facts the event must have: a string fact equals the value, a list fact contains it, a boolean fact equals it. The most specific matching rule (most keys) wins. |
| `rules[].layer` | id | `"main"` | Rules compete per layer: one event plays at most one rule per layer (e.g. "impact" and "accent"). |
| `rules[].effect` | string | required | vfx-effect id to spawn; `{fact}` segments are filled from string facts (a missing fact spawns nothing). |
| `rules[].at` | string | — | Event anchor to spawn at; default: the event’s first anchor. |
| `rules[].socket` | id | — | Socket on the anchor entity (e.g. "hand-r"); default: the effect’s own socket. |
| `rules[].attach` | boolean | `true` | Follow the anchor entity while it exists (when it is destroyed the effect stops emitting and its particles finish); false spawns at where it is now. |
| `rules[].orientTo` | `"hitNormal"` \| `"attackerForward"` | — | Point the effect’s up axis (its launch cone) along a direction of the event: "hitNormal" out of the struck surface, "attackerForward" along the blow. |
| `rules[].scaleBy` | object | — | Scale emission by a number fact (intensity: damage dealt, impact energy…). |
| `rules[].scaleBy.fact` | string | required | A number fact of the event, e.g. "total" or "energy". |
| `rules[].scaleBy.min` | number | required | Fact value at (or below) which the effect emits at `floor`. |
| `rules[].scaleBy.max` | number | required | Fact value at (or above) which the effect emits fully. |
| `rules[].scaleBy.floor` | number 0–1 | `0.25` | Emission at `min`, 0–1; linear up to 1 at `max`. |
| `rules[].stopOn` | list of `"DamageApplied"` \| `"PoiseBroken"` \| `"Died"` \| `"HitParried"` \| `"GuardBroken"` \| `"DodgedHit"` \| `"ActionPhaseChanged"` \| `"LocomotionEvents"` \| `"TelegraphStarted"` \| `"AttackHit"` \| `"AttackProjectileLaunched"` \| `"AttackEnded"` \| `"ActionRejected"` \| `"StaminaExhausted"` \| `"StaminaRecovered"` \| `"fireIgnited"` \| `"fireExtinguished"` \| `"fireBurntOut"` \| `"stimulusResolved"` \| `"propertyChanged"` \| `"factChanged"` \| `"signalReceived"` \| `"volumeEntered"` \| `"volumeExited"` \| `"physicsImpact"` \| `"ArrowFired"` \| `"arrowImpact"` \| `"breakableBroken"` \| `"doorStateChanged"` \| `"doorBlocked"` \| `"lockUnlocked"` \| `"lockRefused"` \| `"switchUsed"` \| `"mechanismJammed"` | `[]` | Events that stop a looping effect this rule started on the same entity (their default anchor), e.g. a fire loop stopped by fireExtinguished. |
| `rules[].cooldownMs` | integer ≥ 0 | `0` | Minimum ms between two spawns of this rule on the same anchor. |
